name: Airline Tycoon
description: Run your own airline. Buy planes, open routes across the real world, and build the airport they fly from.
details:
An airline tycoon built around one home airport. Pick where you fly from, then grow a network across 181 real airports on six continents — great-circle distances, real runway lengths, and a demand model that knows a 200 km hop loses to the train and a 15,000 km one runs out of willing passengers.

The fleet is real aircraft with roughly real numbers: an ATR 72 for thin regional routes, an A320neo or 737 MAX for the bread and butter, a 787 or A350 when you can afford the runway. Lease early when cash is short and it is the cheapest way in the air; keep the lease for a decade and it costs more than buying outright. Every airframe wears, and every 3,000 block hours it disappears into a heavy check for three days.

Fares are the lever. Price under the market and you fill the cabin but leave money behind; price over it and you fly half-empty. The slider shows the load factor and the day's profit as you drag it, using exactly the arithmetic the simulation runs.

The airport is the real progression gate, built on an isometric grid where placement matters as much as purchase. A gate that does not touch a terminal is built, paid for, and completely useless. A hangar that opens onto an apron cuts maintenance further than one stranded in a field. Fuel depots, lounges and cargo terminals each pay off differently, and the longest runway you have laid decides what you are allowed to fly at all — so the widebody you want is behind concrete, not just cash.

The clock runs while you play at 1x, 2x or 4x, and keeps trading while the app is closed: come back and a summary tells you how many days were flown, what they earned, and which aircraft went in for a check. Offline days pay a fraction of a full day including costs, so being away can never bankrupt an airline faster than flying it would.

Everything is stored on your device and the game works entirely offline. On the Orbit and Nova plans you can also sync your airline between devices.
